author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on JMAP-826m.14. If .14 resolves toward 'drop MockBackend entirely' (option i), MockBackend::new_with_account ceases to exist and the inconsistency disappears for free. If .14 keeps MockBackend, then aligning new_with_account / new_with_accounts is a small unblocked fix that should land in the same sweep that addresses the broader MockBackend disposition.
